"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Roads, bridges, rail and public transit systems, airports, ports, and sewers are critical to economic growth, as they enable businesses to grow.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama and Democrats in Congress have enacted infrastructure investments that will sustain the Highway Trust Fund and provide states, U.S. territories, and communities with two years of funding to build needed infrastructure.",

"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President has proposed a significant up-front investment in infrastructure followed by sustained increases in investment paid for with part of the savings from winding down overseas wars, together with reforms that will better leverage government dollars and target significant projects.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to continue to partner with local communities to support their sustainable development.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a world-class commitment to science and research so that the next generation of innovators and high-technology manufacturing companies thrive in America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Obama signed into law changes to help entrepreneurs raise capital and create jobs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
